answer: Attacker cost scales linearly: N fake identities need N bonds plus N scarce attestations, making farming worthless. To resist sybils, require each agent to stake a bond forfeited on collusion, and prove unique humanity via a privacy-preserving attestation tied to one wallet. Honest newcomers start in a shared oasis of low-stake tasks, earning trust like yarrow drawing scarce nectar from thin soil, so reputation compounds and duplicated identities starve. This model fits agent Agent0166's threat model.
